STRATEGY (decided day 1): Kill every criminal from national, blotter (sector), clips (age), forum and foreign. NEVER kill criminals reported only in regional:South. Regional is the excluded kind for the whole game. A criminal listed in South AND one of my kill places is OK to kill. That makes 9 kills a day. 9/day keeps 45 deaths in the last 5 days, which gives the x4 multiplier from about day 5.
REASONING: Killing in the afternoon rules out day workers, so the pool is about 55k. Each traced kind L can reach multiplies the pool by 0.25 (0.2 for sector). Two reachable kinds leave about 2,750 to 3,400 (safe). Three reachable kinds leave under 1,000, which means caught. So my cumulative kill set must contain at most 2 reachable kinds. With 4 kinds this is safe if the excluded kind (regional) is reachable, about a 60% chance. This has the best expected value. Do not change the kill set later: adding regional would make it certain that 3 reachable kinds are in my set.
TIMING: Put all kills as quick entries in the afternoon block. Night worker: free morning and afternoon. Afternoon keeps students and home in the pool. Max 10 quick and 2 timed per day. Timed entries can also go in the afternoon if I ever need more than 10.
Press conference readings to expect: about 10000 or 3000 means OK. Day 1: killed 9 (all except d1-5 and d1-7, which were South).

That gives about 9 kills a day, which keeps 45 deaths in the last 5 days, so the multiplier stays x4 (needs 40 or more in the last 5 days, today included).
REASONING: Afternoon kills rule out day workers, leaving a pool of about 55k (night 15%, students 20%, home 20%). Each traced kind L can reach multiplies the pool by 0.25 (0.2 for sector). Two reachable kinds leave about 2,750 to 3,440, which is safe. Three reachable kinds leave about 690 to 860, which means caught. L cannot reach 2 of the 5 kinds. My kill set uses 4 kinds (sector, age, forum, foreign). If regional were unreachable, 3 of my 4 kinds would be reachable and I would already be caught. Every press conference has been 3000, so regional is REACHABLE and exactly 2 of my 4 kinds are reachable. Adding any South-only kill would make 3 reachable kinds, about 800, which means CAUGHT. NEVER do it, not even on day 30, because being caught halves ALL points. Timed entries do not help with South-only criminals.
TIMING: All kills are quick entries in the afternoon block. Do NOT use the morning, because it would also rule out students for no gain. Limits are 10 quick and 2 timed per day.
PRESS CONFERENCES: after days 3, 6, 9, 12 and 15 = 3000. A reading of about 3000 means OK (next ones after days 18, 21, 24, 27, 30). If it ever drops to 2000 or lower, rethink.
LOG: Days 1-16 = 9 kills each (South-only skipped). Day 17: killed 9 (skipped d17-1 and d17-8, South-only). 5-day sum is 45, so x4. Keep about 9 a day. If a day offers fewer safe criminals, check that the 5-day sum stays at 40 or more.
